legal.label: PanoVision / Legal
legal.notice: This notice describes the current implementation, not a completed legal policy. PanoVision must confirm its business details, providers, legal grounds, rights procedure and retention schedule before launch.

accounts.heading: Customer accounts
accounts.text: Registration stores your name, company, email, phone, optional country and role, language preference and a salted password hash. Contact details are not published. Company membership controls access to campaigns. Password changes sign out older sessions. When email delivery is configured, changing email requires your password and codes from both inboxes. Initial signup email verification and account recovery are not yet implemented.

campaigns.heading: Campaign requests and creatives
campaigns.text: When you choose Upload & check creative, campaign details are stored as a draft and the file is uploaded separately to private storage. Records may exist before final submission, even if upload fails or you leave. File information, versions, review results and review history are recorded. A final request requires current creative approval; it is not a booking or payment. This version does not send campaign email notifications.

contact.heading: Contact messages
contact.text: The contact form prepares a draft locally, without delivering it or storing it on the server. The email link opens your email app; sending is your choice. Downloaded summaries contain file information, not the creative itself.

access.heading: Private access and review
access.text: Creatives are not placed in the public website folder. Authorized reviewers and the owning company can access eligible media through protected, integrity-checked routes. Security checks, restricted handling and retention can prevent preview or approval. An incomplete automated check never approves content. Playback reports show only recorded evidence; requested dates do not create delivery statistics.

processing.heading: External processing
processing.text: If OpenAI moderation is enabled, images or extracted video frames, advertisement text and extracted audio needed for transcription may be sent for review. This may include confidential information inside the creative. Responses API calls request store:false, which does not promise zero provider retention. PanoVision must verify provider settings, contracts, processing locations and international transfers before activation. Live provider credentials and a security scanner are not configured for this handoff.

storage.heading: Cookies and browser storage
storage.text: Private customer sessions use an HttpOnly cookie with a seven-day lifetime; staff sessions last eight hours. Language choice uses a one-year preference cookie. Map choices and campaign identifiers are kept in tab session storage to help resume planning. Signing back into your account restores access to saved campaigns even after browser storage is cleared.

retention.heading: Retention
retention.text: Default media targets are two days after rejection, seven days for manual review and ninety days after approval. A later decision can reset this period. Deletion depends on the worker running, not an exact-time guarantee. Critical restricted content is blocked from preview and marked for prompt media removal. Media deletion does not delete campaign details, file metadata or audit history. General record deletion, backup retention and rights requests still need a documented operational process before launch.

services.heading: Website services and logs
services.text: There is no advertising tracker or analytics integration. Fonts and map data are served locally. Operational review events are recorded; rate limiting may use a shortened network-address hash when a trusted proxy is configured. Hosts may keep separate access logs. PanoVision must document hosting, log retention and the responsible business details. External links have their own privacy practices.

network.heading: Network development
network.text: PanoVision is in pilot planning. City markers and boundaries are geographic context, not confirmed screens or available inventory. Concept visuals are illustrative mockups.

requests.heading: Campaign requests
requests.text: A request does not reserve a display or confirm a campaign. Locations, dates, creative suitability, specifications and pricing are reviewed before business approval. Payment follows the accepted quote. Creative moderation approval alone is not campaign approval.

formats.heading: Creative specifications
formats.text: Video creatives use an 8-second format. Screen dimensions and final file requirements vary by location. Local image and video previews are conceptual, not guarantees of actual brightness, scale or delivery.

preview.heading: Estimates and preview functions
preview.text: Estimates appear only when real rates and a currency are configured. They do not confirm availability or an accepted quote. Contact drafts are not delivered messages. Playback evidence is shown only when it has been recorded and verified; automatic screen integration is not connected.

launch.heading: Before launch
launch.text: Final terms must address contracting parties, creative permissions, content review, payment, cancellation, schedule changes, delivery, liability and dispute resolution. These commercial terms need professional review and have not been finalized.
